text: かぜに　のって　はしってたら　とべそう！

structure.en: I feel like I could fly!

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'when'. Here it sits on はしってる, the short spoken form of はしっている 'be running'. はしってたら = 'if I keep on running'.

patterns.name: 〜そうだ
patterns.explanation: そう stuck onto a shortened verb means 'it looks like' or 'it feels like it will'. とべそう = 'I feel like I could fly'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing とぶ 'to fly' to とべる gives 'can fly'. とべそう = 'seems like I can fly'.
